universityName: EPFL – École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne
description: AI-powered chatbot and semantic search of EPFL academic content (Graph Search); sign in to use Chat with Graph Search. Course-specific AI tutors are deployed within participating courses by instructors.
howToObtain: Open Graph Search; sign in to use Chat with Graph Search. Course-specific AI tutors are accessible in participating courses where the teaching team has deployed them (such as Moodle or Ed Discussion). Access to the tool does not grant permission to use it for graded assessments without instructor authorization.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: AI powered chatbot and semantic search of EPFL’s academic content. Ask it to help you solve and exercise and it will suggest relevant video lectures and relatred excercises.

universityName: EPFL – École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne
description: Enterprise Copilot accessible through an EPFL account, with a regulated-data restriction.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: EPFL's guidance says enterprise Microsoft 365 Copilot is available via an EPFL account, but is not currently secure for regulated data because EPFL has no signed data-processing agreement.

universityName: EPFL – École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne
description: CEDE offers customizable course AI chatbots integrated into a course website or discussion forum, using retrieval-augmented generation with course materials to reduce hallucination risk.
howToObtain: Available within participating courses where configured and deployed by the course teaching team on course websites or discussion forums (such as Moodle or Ed Discussion).

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Interested in adding a chatbot to your course? We can help you create a chatbot with a specific focus on your course using local AI models and documents you share.
